name: Lionfish
summary: A red lionfish is seen on a Leonida Keys reef in Rockstar's launch screenshot gallery.
body: GTA Wiki lists lionfish among the game's aquatic animals, from a red lionfish swimming in the Leonida Keys in an official launch-gallery screenshot.
GTA Wiki places them in the Gulf of Leonida.

facts.habitat: Leonida Keys reefs, Gulf of Leonida

name: Stingray
summary: Stingrays are seen swimming in a group in Rockstar's Extended Look video.
body: GTA Wiki lists stingrays among the game's aquatic animals and shows a group of them in a scene from Rockstar's Extended Look video.
GTA Wiki also points to a photo of a woman posing behind a dead stingray on the wall of The Rusty Anchor, in the background of an official Cal Hampton screenshot.
The app already has a Manta Ray entry; GTA Wiki treats stingrays as a separate animal.

name: Carolina Dog
summary: A Carolina dog is seen sleeping beside Marabunta Grande members in an official screenshot.
body: GTA Wiki's dog list includes a Carolina dog, from an official screenshot published by Edge magazine showing one asleep beside members of the Marabunta Grande.
GTA Wiki's animal table also lists Carolina dogs among the game's land animals.
